findings: safe_name accepts dot as a file member path; require a nonempty component path excluding dot.

verify_tree accepts an ancestor-directory symlink to outside root when leaf file hashes match; path.is_symlink on the leaf is insufficient. Reject symlink ancestors/roots and require resolved containment for all evidence reads.
static_completion_observations: Complete gates only count selected/results rows; they do not yet ensure unique complete task-arm-seed-budget alias coverage or exact selected-checkpoint equality with scored rows.

Complete gates currently do not require the trained numerical/runtime appendix receipts or independent final artifact audit. Add these as completion/integrity requirements, while preserving numerical/scientific failed or unresolved statuses.

verify_tree verifies declared members but does not reject extra in-scope files; exact-tree verification should compare the relevant inventory to the manifest, with explicit release/pycache exclusions.
